title: Authenticate accepted source updates in historical reconciliation checks
body:
The aggregate reconciliation check rejected two accepted upstream maintenance updates, then ran the frozen reconciliation92 audit against the extended live Makefile. This follow-up to #2026 makes the historical checks replay with their original evidence while recognizing only the exact accepted successor bytes.

- For frontier890's spectrum `RESULT.json` / `SOURCE.json`, authenticate the original receipt hashes after reversing the single source-digest replacement accepted in Sagar Thakrar's `02c46c7e`. Also bind the current helper to that exact successor hash. Every other byte, including all 41 mathematical cases, remains required.
- For batch932's isolated runner and regression test, accept only the exact predecessor/successor blob pairs from woklerx's assertion-safety update `2b7dc6cf`. Changes to assertion protection, payloads, unrelated files or receipt pins still fail.
- Reuse #2026's authenticated isolated reconciliation92 replay from the aggregate checker; the original checker and historical Makefile pin are preserved. Extend the existing scoped CI job's path filters and adapter tests, and allow the same path-scoped job on contributor branches for fork verification.

Started from current main `e112d71c`. No historical coverage receipt, frozen archive, selected-result record, mathematical result or contributor decision is edited. Changes are limited to the aggregate checker, its regression tests and its existing workflow.

Validation on Windows / Python 3.11 with `PYTHONUTF8=1`:

- `python -B scripts/verify_pr_reconciliation.py`: PASS, 1,685 attributed PR records; reconciliation92 plus the later full-tree source inventories and receipts pass.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*reconciliation*.py'`: 37 tests pass; the same suite passes under `-O`.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py`: 7 isolation/source-pin/corruption tests pass.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_isolated_test_runner.py -v`: 4 tests pass, including inherited optimization rejection.
- `python -B research/single-intersection-spectrum-audit/spectrum_audit.py`: all 41 cases and package rejection controls pass.
- `git diff --check origin/main`: pass. Exact successor hashes were checked against the accepted Git objects, not inferred from working bytes.

Hosted Ubuntu 24.04 / Python 3.12 scoped checks passed at head `7428274c`: https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38614370948. This includes the full aggregate reconciliation audit, adapter/reconciliation rejection controls, exact accelerators and the unchanged-output gate. The separate full research matrix is still running. This is an integrity/CI repair, not a new multiplication bound, selected cold replay or full theorem verification. No PR is merged or closed by this work.

Credit ljste's spectrum audit, Sagar Thakrar's source-pin repair, woklerx's assertion-safety repair, and the repository's historical reconciliation authors. Prepared by Dennis (`antunishdPursuit`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18930177
